description: Frameo turns a prompt into a finished short video inside ChatGPT. It generates images, video clips, voiceovers, music, and sound effects in the user's Frameo workspace, keeps characters and style consistent across shots, and assembles the clips with ffmpeg and motion-graphics templates into a final cut. Users can also upload or import their own media, browse a free sound-effect library, and read back a project's canvas and Library. Every credit-spending generation is quoted first with estimate_cost and runs only after the user confirms.

defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second sci-fi short film — script, shots, music, and final render.
Turn this product photo into a 15-second ad with voiceover and music.
Create me a UGC-style testimonial clip with on-screen captions for my product.
